name: WindowsScene
description: Windows 11 File Explorer scene with raw chrome slots and optional generated Explorer folder-grid content.

theme.description: Visual theme. Currently optimized for light File Explorer chrome.

titlebarTabsHtml.description: Raw HTML for File Explorer title-bar tabs.

navTreeHtml.description: Raw HTML for left navigation tree.

contentHtml.description: Raw HTML for main pane content. Leave empty when using itemsJson.

statusLeftHtml.description: Raw HTML for the left side of the status bar.

statusRightHtml.description: Raw HTML for the right side of the status bar.

viewMode.description: Generated content mode. Use largeIcons with itemsJson for realistic File Explorer folders.

sectionLabel.description: Optional uppercase section label above generated content.

selectedItem.description: Optional generated item name to render as selected.

itemsJson.description: JSON-encoded generated Explorer items: [{"type":"folder","name":"target-repo-01"}]. Supports folder and file item types.
